notes.title: The new game "Lunar Mirror" is coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hello gentlemen!
After a long period of development, our first horror game, Lunar Mirror, is finally here.
This time we have put a lot of energy into the gameplay, I believe that friends who like to explore game decryption will not be disappointed.

"Lunar Mirror" is a Cthulhu series of horror games, focusing on exploration and decryption.

The story takes place in a remote university, a sudden astronomical vision locks you and the whole school in the remote school, and your girlfriend leaves without saying goodbye, allowing you to start exploring the entire campus. The sudden rise of the mysterious society is related to your missing girlfriend, and they seem to take pleasure in love...
In order to find a girlfriend, you have to step into the darkness of the campus at night, explore the secrets buried in the campus, meet girls wandering around at night, encounter indescribable terror...until the moment when the truth comes
The game is currently in the pre-emptive version, and more plots will be unlocked later. At the same time, we will also update the game content in a timely manner based on player feedback, and welcome your comments and feedback. The subsequent chapters of the game are also in production, so stay tuned!
The game is about to be launched, you can add a wishlist first, there are discounts for the first launch, don't miss it!

notes.title: Big news!!" Rebirth:Beware of Mr.Wang " is coming online!!!

We are here with a new game!
That's right, the long-awaited rebirth of the Pharaoh series! "Rebirth:Beware of Mr.Wang"
The game will be officially launched in early October!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1517960/_/
This is a plot-oriented interactive puzzle game, the game is played by clicking or dragging the mouse to promote the development of the plot.

The game tells the story of an ordinary young man who fell into decadence after failing to pursue the goddess. At this time, he obtained the Eye of Truth from a mysterious bartender and opened the perspective ability, and then he went to open life!
During this process, the protagonist will also meet the cute little god of death and start an interesting cohabitation life.
However, the power of the Eye of Truth is limited in time. In order to obtain permanent or even stronger abilities, the protagonist can only ascend to heaven to get baptism and complete a task. The protagonist feels vaguely that there is a huge conspiracy behind this endless enjoyment in heaven.
Who is the mysterious person who has appeared to hinder the male lead several times? Who is the identity of what bartender? After all, who will the male lead choose to go with him? Waiting for you to choose!
The game uses a dynamic comic expression form, the game has multiple branches, a multi-role ending, and a hidden ending (≖ ‿ ≖)✧. 
Compared with the first step, the volume of the game has increased by more than three times! 
More than 250 plot illustrations!
40 CG illustrations that you know!

A work of true sincerity!

notes.title: The new game "Seek GirlⅧ" is now officially launched
notes.notes:
The new game "Seek GirlⅧ" is now officially launched
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1509090/Seek_Girl/
This game is a strategy adventure game. The player needs to control the boy to find the girl before entering the next level. There are many obstacles and pitfalls in this process. Players need to make timely adjustments based on progress. There are many elemental balls on the game map, and each elemental serve has its own unique usage. Collect and use them correctly to complete the game correctly. Please note that picking up or using elemental orbs also counts as one round.

Compared with the previous Sokoban games, the difficulty of the game is much lower, easy to use, and the CG quality has also been improved.

In addition, here is a preview of our new game： "Rebirth indulge in heaven" (tentative)

notes.title: very sorry! Game official launch time supplement
notes.notes:
We are very sorry that due to the development progress, the original scheduled launch time will be delayed by a few days.

"Rebirth: Mr Wang" has added many new gameplay and plots, and the content and workload of the game have doubled. The game flow requires multiple adjustments. In order to give players a better gaming experience, we decided to postpone the release of the game.

We are stepping up the optimization of the game and will complete the optimization of the game in the fastest time.
Thank you for your understanding and support.
